newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed in quiet trading.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mixed on Monday, with trading quiet as market participants waited for the USDA's November crop production report due to be released on Tuesday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 60 yen lower to 50 yen higher, and the benchmark November 1997 contract was steady at 14,270 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 30,381 lots.

Light technical selling by individual investors pushed down distant month contracts from the opening, traders said. "But most participants were sidelined ahead of the USDA crop report," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.67-1/2 per bushel at 0835 GMT, against $2.67-1/2 at Friday's close.
The spot November of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.89-1/2 at 0835 GMT, against $6.87-3/4 at Friday's close.
